The bounded [Tian nano-Ti composite increment](experimental/material-batches/tian-nano-ti-composites-20261024/INTEGRATION.md) adds two study-qualified nominal Mg-3Al-1Zn/nano-Ti formulations with one as-extruded measured density each. Nominal reinforcement loadings are not analyzed final compositions. Density conditions and statistics remain unknown; tensile-only conditions, theoretical densities and the unreinforced comparator are excluded.

### Tian 2023 nominal nano-Ti composite density facts

Wei Tian, Pengfei Gao, Shengli Han, Xiaohong Chen, Fuwei Zhang, Yuhui Zhang,
Tiegang Luo and Kaihong Zheng (2023), *Effect of Nano-Ti Particles on
Microstructure and Mechanical Properties of Mg-3Al-1Zn Matrix Composites*,
Materials 16(6), 2407, [DOI 10.3390/ma16062407](https://doi.org/10.3390/ma16062407).
These are the eight author contributors. Bolv Xiao is the Academic Editor.
Copyright 2023 by the authors; licensee MDPI, Basel, Switzerland. The
article-specific permissions in the official archive and the publisher-formatted
PDF page 1 identify [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

Changes are transcription of two selected Table 2 Actual Density cells and
nominal reinforcement/state qualifications, with explicit unknowns. The 0.5 wt%
and 1 wt% nano-Ti additions are nominal formulations, not analyzed final
compositions. The literal second source label `1 wt Ti` is preserved; methods
provide its separate nominal 1 wt% qualification. The densities describe the
as-extruded composites. Density temperature, pressure, humidity, specimen count,
repetitions, aggregation, uncertainty, density basis and porosity are unknown.
Tensile n=3 and room temperature are not assigned to density. Theoretical
density, tensile properties and the unreinforced comparator are excluded.

def regression_checkpoint_bytes(relative):
    """Recover only a frozen Kapoor resource for historical regression assertions.

    Execution paths never opt into this view. Successor helpers must first
    validate the actual current graph or file; immutable Git bytes are only
    the final equality check, never a fallback for unknown current content.
    """
    data_paths = {'materials_boundaries/data/' + name for name in RESOURCE_HASHES}
    allowed = data_paths | set(CANDIDATE_ARTIFACTS) | {
        '.github/workflows/ci.yml',
        'experimental/platform/ci/required_test_ids.json',
        'experimental/platform/query-service/materials_query/pins/legacy_baseline.json',
    }
    require(type(relative) is str and relative in allowed,
            'Unknown Kapoor regression checkpoint resource')
    import material_append_successors as successors
    require(Path(successors.__file__).resolve() == (ROOT / 'tests/material_append_successors.py').resolve(),
            'Historical recovery must use the checkout test-only successor registry')
    path = ROOT / relative
    require(not path.is_symlink() and path.is_file() and path.resolve().is_relative_to(ROOT.resolve()),
            'Historical regression resource must be a regular repository file')
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    if relative in data_paths:
        raw = successors.project_successor_catalog_bytes(
            Path(relative).name, raw, before=KAPOOR_BATCH_ID)
    else:
        raw = successors.project_successor_file(relative, raw, before=KAPOOR_BATCH_ID)
    require(raw == git('show', REGRESSION_CHECKPOINT + ':' + relative),
            'Unreviewed Kapoor regression checkpoint successor: ' + relative)
    return raw
